The '''CC-7700/E interdiction cruiser''', nicknamed the '''Double Seven''' or '''Slash-E''', was a model of the [[CC-7700 frigate/Legends|CC-7700 frigate]].

==Characteristics==
Compared to the original CC-7700 model, it had upgraded armor and weaponry. Its six shield generators were complemented by a [[carbon-nanofilament armor]] [[Hull/Legends|hull]]. Defensive weaponry included eight [[Quad laser cannon/Legends|quad laser cannons]] upgraded to be almost as powerful as [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]-era [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] and a large number of anti-starfighter [[Cluster bomb/Legends|cluster bombs]], designed to go off in case of the proximity of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. It was thought that even if a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] could slip through the defenses of one of these ships, it would need to travel at almost its full velocity to be able to pierce the augmented hull.

The ship could project a gravity well of several hundred planetary diameters. Numerous cruiser's fields would be overlapped to create an even larger interdicted area.

==History==
Five of these cruisers participated in the [[Battle of Mindor]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], where they constituted the [[Rapid Response Task Force]]'s complement of interdictors. At least three of these ships were destroyed during the course of the battle.
